_comment: Deterministic skeleton for BUILD_AGENT_RESULT.json. The builder agent MUST copy this file verbatim into the per-run scratch path, then fill in the values. Every required field name, casing, and enum value is part of the contract — do not rename, lowercase, or omit. The deterministic build finalizer refuses any agent result that does not validate against this shape.
work_unit_id: <fill: e.g. UNIT-1 — must match a work unit in the approved packet>
_outcome_requested_enum: Must be exactly one of: candidate_ready | blocked | stopped — lowercase, underscore, no quotes mismatch.
summary: <fill: one-paragraph plain text summary of what was done and what the validators said>

evidence.pytest_offline_summary: <fill: last lines of pytest output, plain text>

notes: <fill: anything the reviewer/finalizer should know that is not visible from the diff>
